body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. The target suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Prowess attack before your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, move 1 unit around the target.

rider.title: Combo - Finisher
rider.html: After a hit, you may spend 2 Combo to extend the Fortitude penalty to the next attack by any creature instead; it still expires at your next turn.
